coordinate_system: top-left-origin, right-bottom-exclusive for display review; runtime positions are fixed Turtle WoW 1.12 Frame:SetPoint offsets relative to UIParent at pfUI tier 8, with no physical-screen projection, effective-scale multiplication, probe, or coordinate readback

evidence.provider: addon/pfUI unitframes/castbar/swingtimer/actionbar + installed DoiteDPS + optional installed ArchiTotem 1.7
evidence.layout_formula: pfUI tier 8 remains global; the explicit one-shot preset writes native UIParent coordinates directly: Combat Deck BOTTOM (0,175), player/target BOTTOM (-212,492)/(213,492), paired cast bars BOTTOM (-212,454)/(213,454), swing CENTER (0,-67), stance TOP (0,-919), and DoiteDPS TOPLEFT (1012,-647); units/casts use local scale 0.75 and swing/stance/DoiteDPS use 0.82
evidence.runtime_v1_4_failure: game-geometry-failed: UIParent:GetWidth/GetHeight and target provider scales were mixed, shifting the unit frames, cast bars, swing timer, stance bar, DoiteDPS and Combat Deck away from the accepted V5 composition
evidence.runtime_v1_5_failure: game-geometry-failed: GetScreenWidth/GetScreenHeight returned physical 1920x1080 while SetPoint and pfUI saved positions consumed the normalized game coordinate space; the one-unit probe plus effective-scale readback therefore translated every native offset a second time and scattered the composition
evidence.target: Turtle WoW 1.18.1; audited 1920x1080 client to 2560x1440 display chain
evidence.atlas_role: layout-only runtime contract; no source or runtime bitmap is introduced
evidence.dynamic_ownership: all health, power, aura, spell, timer, cooldown, totem, skip, recall, preset, tooltip, drag, lock and hit behavior remains provider-owned
evidence.runtime_scope: explicit /aeui focuslayout apply or comfort writes the fixed game-native pfUI/DoiteDPS coordinates plus their signature and requests ArchiTotem direction=down; /aeui focuslayout restore restores the captured pre-apply profile; ordinary Apply never maintains player/target/cast/swing/stance/DoiteDPS geometry and only event-binds the detected ArchiTotem root when fieldKitBound=true
